target_pid.description: The Process ID (PID) of the running program to attach to. 0 means no specific PID (e.g., if launching a new command).

use_tty_stealing.description: Use the -T flag for TTY-stealing mode. More reliable in some circumstances, but may require root for sshd children.

verbose_output.description: Use the -V flag to print verbose debug output.

force_fd_attach.description: Use the -s flag to unconditionally attach stdin/stdout/stderr even if the target has no controlling terminal.

launch_command.description: Optional command and args to run with -l or -L, creating a new pty pair. If empty, reptyr attaches to an existing PID.

options.description: A list of additional raw CLI arguments to pass to reptyr.
